summary: Plan written: nine sequential phases, 15 hours, porting the sorry-free research probe into the library as Semantics/HistoryMorphism.lean, Truth.box_always_iff, and two root-level object-language components (HybridLanguage: L+ with [≡], state registers and the binder; QuantLanguage: L with propositional quantifiers over an admissible family). 24 Lean challenge statements, type-checked against the live source modules at plan time. The plan re-sites the port away from the research-era Semantics/Extension/ paths, which predate the language-directory merge; the probe itself now compiles only against stale oleans and is treated as a mirror record of proofs.
